title: Science Electives
stem:
A class of 50 first-year science students each chose to study some combination of Biology, Chemistry, and Physics this term, or none of them.

8 students study only Biology. 6 study only Chemistry. 7 study only Physics. 4 students study Biology and Chemistry but not Physics. 3 study Biology and Physics but not Chemistry. 5 study Chemistry and Physics but not Biology. 2 students study all three subjects. The remaining students study none of these subjects.

Which of the following diagrams best represents the data?
answer_reason: Biology only = 8, Chemistry only = 6, Physics only = 7, Biology and Chemistry only = 4, Biology and Physics only = 3, Chemistry and Physics only = 5, all three = 2 (subtotal 35). With 50 students total, 15 study none. Only option A matches every region. Option B swaps Biology only and Chemistry only. Option C swaps the Biology+Chemistry and Biology+Physics overlap counts. Option D shows 4 in the all-three region instead of 2.

title: Music School Grades
stem:
A music school enrols 83 pupils. Each pupil studies one or two of the following grades: Grade 1, Grade 2, Grade 3, Grade 4.

22 pupils study only Grade 1. 18 study only Grade 2. 15 study only Grade 3. 10 study only Grade 4. 6 pupils study Grade 1 and Grade 2. 5 pupils study Grade 2 and Grade 3. 4 pupils study Grade 3 and Grade 4. The remaining pupils are temporarily withdrawn from all grades.

Which of the following diagrams best represents the data?
answer_reason: Single-grade pupils: 22 + 18 + 15 + 10 = 65. Pair pupils: 6 + 5 + 4 = 15. Subtotal 80. Withdrawn: 83 - 80 = 3. Only option A matches every value. Option B shifts pupils from Grade 1 only into the Grade 1 + Grade 2 overlap. Option C swaps the Grade 3 only and Grade 4 only counts. Option D balances the three overlap counts to 5 each, which contradicts the stated values.

title: Fitness Class Crossover
stem:
A studio runs three weekly fitness classes: Yoga, Pilates, and HIIT. 70 members are on the register.

18 members attend only Yoga. 12 attend only Pilates. 14 attend only HIIT. 6 members attend both Yoga and Pilates. 8 members attend both Yoga and HIIT. 12 members are currently on a break and attend none of the classes.

Which of the following diagrams best represents the data?
answer_reason: Single-class members: 18 + 12 + 14 = 44. Yoga and Pilates = 6, Yoga and HIIT = 8 (subtotal 58). On a break = 12. Total = 70. The stem does not mention any Pilates and HIIT crossover, so that overlap is 0 and is omitted. Only option A matches every stated value. Option B swaps the Yoga only and Pilates only counts. Option C swaps the two overlap counts. Option D shifts 2 members between the Yoga only and the overlap regions.

title: Heart Disease Risk by Age
stem:
A GP clinic classifies adult patients by age band (20–39, 40–59, 60–79, 80+) and separately records whether each patient has been assessed as being at risk of heart disease.

Each letter marks a different region of the diagram.

Which letter represents a patient aged 60–79 who has also been assessed as being at risk of heart disease?
answer_reason: A patient aged 60–79 who is at risk of heart disease lies inside both the Aged 60–79 shape and the At risk of heart disease shape, but outside every other age band. That region is marked W. Letter S marks patients aged 60–79 who are not at risk. Letter V marks patients aged 40–59 who are at risk. Letter X marks patients aged 80+ who are at risk.

title: Year Group Bridging
stem:
A primary school enrols every pupil in one of Years 1 to 5. A small number of pupils are bridging two consecutive year groups this term while they finish content from the lower year before joining the next.

Each letter marks a different region of the diagram.

Which letter represents a pupil who is bridging Year 3 and Year 4?
answer_reason: A pupil bridging Year 3 and Year 4 lies inside both the Year 3 shape and the Year 4 shape, but outside every other year. That region is marked W. Letter R marks pupils who are only in Year 3. Letter V marks pupils bridging Year 2 and Year 3. Letter X marks pupils bridging Year 4 and Year 5.

title: Specialist Referrals
stem:
A community clinic logs each appointment by which specialty the patient attended. Patients attend exactly one specialty per appointment. Separately, each appointment is recorded as having been booked via a specialist referral or as a routine self-booking.

Each letter marks a different region of the diagram.

Which letter represents an appointment in Cardiology that was booked via a specialist referral?
answer_reason: An appointment in Cardiology booked via a specialist referral lies inside both the Cardiology shape and the Specialist referral shape. That region is marked W. Letter R marks Cardiology appointments that were self-booked rather than referred. Letter V marks Geriatrics appointments booked via referral. Letter X marks Dermatology appointments booked via referral.

title: Music School Grades
stem:
A music school registers every pupil for at least one of the following six grades. A small number of pupils are studying two consecutive grades at the same time while they prepare to move up.

Each letter marks a different region of the diagram.

Which letter represents a pupil who is studying both Grade 5 and Grade 6?
answer_reason: A pupil studying both Grade 5 and Grade 6 lies inside both the Grade 5 shape and the Grade 6 shape, but outside every other grade. That region is marked X. Letter W marks pupils studying both Grade 4 and Grade 5. Letter Y marks pupils studying both Grade 6 and Grade 7. Letter R marks pupils registered only for Grade 5.

title: Hospital Patient Care
stem:
The diagram classifies a hospital's currently admitted patients by their care status. A separate group of visiting outpatients attend day clinics on the ward but are not admitted to the hospital.

Each letter marks a different region of the diagram.

Which letter represents an admitted patient who is post-operative and has a chronic illness, but is not on Medication X, not aged 65 or over, does not require isolation, and is not a visiting outpatient?
answer_reason: A patient who is post-operative and has a chronic illness but is not on Medication X, not aged 65+, not requiring isolation, and not a visiting outpatient lies inside the Admitted patients rectangle, inside the Post-operative and Chronic illness shapes, and outside every other shape. That region is marked V. Letter W marks chronically ill patients who are also on Medication X. Letter Q marks post-operative patients only. Letter T marks elderly patients only.

title: Leisure Centre Passes
stem:
A leisure centre classifies its registered members by which facility passes they hold: Swimming pool, Gym, and Sauna. Members may hold any combination of the three. The centre also receives day-visit guests on a pay-per-entry basis, and tournament athletes from external clubs who train at the centre during competitions but are not registered members.

Each letter marks a different region of the diagram.

Which letter represents a registered member who holds passes for the Swimming pool, the Gym and the Sauna?
answer_reason: A member who holds all three passes lies inside the Swimming pool, Gym and Sauna shapes simultaneously. That region is marked V. Letter S marks members with only the Swimming pool and Gym passes. Letter T marks members with only the Swimming pool and Sauna passes. Letter U marks members with only the Gym and Sauna passes.
